summary_ja: 同時決済取引で経過営業日数が五日以上の場合に再構築コストに経過日数に応じたリスク・ウェイト（百〜千二百五十パーセント）を適用し、非同時決済取引は約定決済日の五営業日以後千二百五十パーセントとする等の未決済取引の取扱いを定める。
summary_en: Failed trades: DvP trades 5+ business days late weight their replacement cost at 100% to 1,250% by days elapsed; non-DvP trades where we have delivered are weighted by counterparty until 4 days after settlement, then 1,250%.
paragraphs: Where the number of business days elapsed for a delivery-versus-payment transaction has reached five days or more, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach shall treat as credit risk-weighted assets the amount obtained by multiplying the replacement cost of that transaction (meaning, where securities, etc. are to be delivered, the contract amount less the market value of the securities, etc. of the transaction, and where securities, etc. are to be received, the market value of the securities, etc. of the transaction less the contract amount; provided, however, that neither shall be below zero; the same applies hereinafter in this Section and in Chapter 4, Section 3, Subsection 8) by the risk weight specified in the lower column of the following table according to the number of business days elapsed listed in its upper column. {{T:p122t0}}

Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach has, in a non-delivery-versus-payment transaction, delivered securities, etc. or paid funds to the counterparty and the counter-transaction has not been settled, it shall proceed as follows. (i) For the period from the date on which the securities, etc. were delivered or the funds were paid until four business days after the contractual settlement date of the counter-transaction, the amount obtained by multiplying the contract amount of that non-delivery-versus-payment transaction by the risk weight provided in Article 22 through Article 34 according to the type of counterparty shall be the credit risk-weighted assets. (ii) From the fifth business day after the contractual settlement date of the counter-transaction, the amount obtained by multiplying the contract amount of that non-delivery-versus-payment transaction (where the replacement cost of that non-delivery-versus-payment transaction exceeds zero, the sum of that contract amount and the replacement cost) by a risk weight of 1,250% shall be the credit risk-weighted assets.

In the case of item (i) of the preceding paragraph, where the total amount of exposures relating to non-delivery-versus-payment transactions is recognized as not material, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach may use a risk weight of 100% for all of those non-delivery-versus-payment transactions in place of the risk weights provided in Article 22 through Article 34.

Where some of the number of business days elapsed in paragraph (1) or of the number of business days after the contractual settlement date in paragraph (2) are attributable to a system-wide failure of an external settlement system, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach may exclude those days from the number of business days elapsed in paragraph (1) or the number of business days after the contractual settlement date in paragraph (2).

In the cases of each of the preceding paragraphs, in calculating credit risk-weighted assets, a conversion factor of 100% shall be applied to the exposures relating to the delivery-versus-payment transactions or non-delivery-versus-payment transactions provided in those paragraphs.
